confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates are least certain given July peak-season swings. Cocktail and wine were set from their approximate ratio to draft beer because direct knowledge is weaker. USD values assume about 1.16 USD per euro. The FX value (0.7002 USD per AUD, dated 14 Oct 2026) was reported from RBA search results, but I could not open the RBA table or corroborate it independently, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors were reasoned from general knowledge of southern European city-break pricing, with Porto, Seville and Athens as rough peers, and Lisbon accommodation set higher to reflect July peak-season demand.
